proposals.title: RAW UNREVIEWED: the same action proposition can be instructed, intended, then reported without three physical executions
proposals.summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED. A whole-content account could connect a stated goal, an instruction concerning one participant and a later reported outcome while preserving one action proposition. A rival executes every action-shaped mention and therefore invents duplicate operations. This is speculative commitment scope, with missing written mode cues and no current word gloss.

design.mechanism: Introduce an action proposition and typed participant; put it under a goal or command scope; later report whether that same action occurred or achieved the goal. The repeated action's content may persist while speaker commitment changes. A command does not itself entail an actual event; a desired endpoint does not entail success.
design.unit: Two complete already-exposed prose contexts, including every exact group and alternative reading, nominated before new meanings. Exact context/source IDs and prospective meaning bindings are missing; producer reads no manuscript bodies.
design.contrast: One proposition reused across intention/instruction/report with one optional actual episode versus every mention creating an actual event, or every purpose automatically asserting achievement.
design.prediction: Freeze atomic values and one explicit scope grammar before comparing two whole contexts. The instructed action must supply a paid participant and the later report must refer to that action or its result through written evidence. A later failure or non-achievement can coexist with the original goal but contradicts a reading that asserted earlier success. Every group contributes or remains UNKNOWN; unread intervals cannot silently close commitment scope.
design.scope: New exploratory construction only; no manuscript/source identification, no current-model repair and no source-based endorsement.

proposals.title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a named comparison control is introduced and re-used without becoming the processed patient
proposals.summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED. A whole passage may choose a comparison control, evaluate an owned sample against it and draw a relation or branch decision. A later nominal can return to the chosen standard while the processed sample persists separately. The speculative distinction is reference role versus action patient, not another metal name or a free reference repair.

design.mechanism: Introduce sample and standard separately; state the measured or observed property used for comparison; retain the chosen standard through the comparison conclusion or a later selection. Only the explicitly processed participant bears a material-changing action. A comparator mention is an argument of comparison, not automatically a new operation input.

design.contrast: Persistent sample plus selected standard/comparison result versus latest-nominal patient substitution, or two nominal mentions interpreted as successive transformation products.

Swapping comparator and patient must produce an explicit changed ordering or decision; English coherence and reference proximity are insufficient.

proposals.title: RAW UNREVIEWED: recipe specification, one produced batch and its deposited result occupy different reference domains
proposals.summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED. A whole account may state a reusable preparation specification, introduce a batch satisfying it, then deposit or retain a result from that batch. Repeating the recipe-type noun can return to the specification without asserting physical identity with every product. Deposited results must still have explicit batch provenance and location; no silent class-to-individual coercion.

design.mechanism: Introduce a preparation class/specification; a written production or instantiation clause enters a batch; an explicit deposition/retention clause enters a located result linked to that batch. Type predicates apply to the specification, episode operations to the batch and location/state predicates to the deposited result, with paid transitions between these domains.
design.unit: Two complete already-exposed prose contexts, including every exact group and alternative reading, nominated before new meanings. Exact context/source IDs and prospective meaning bindings are missing; producer reads no manuscript bodies.
design.contrast: Three typed reference domains with explicit instantiation/provenance versus every repeated preparation name denoting one physical object, or every nominal creating a new batch without a written production.
design.prediction: Freeze TYPE, BATCH and LOCATED_RESULT sorts and the exact productions before reading them into the full paired contexts. Each batch/result requires a written entry and provenance relation. Returning to a type cannot by itself re-enter an old physical batch. A later result-location assertion must bind the deposited result rather than merely naming the recipe. UNKNOWNs cannot supply missing creation/deposition clauses.
design.scope: Speculative whole-content typed-reference approach only; no new recipe nouns, forced two products, batch identity repair, material-quality inheritance or implementation of a serializer.

proposals.title: RAW UNREVIEWED: a reported failed procedure motivates a superseding instruction without erasing the earlier episode
proposals.summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_UNTESTED. A whole narrative or technical account may record an attempted procedure and an observed failure, diagnose a mismatched condition, then issue a revised instruction. The earlier attempted event remains part of history while its recommendation loses force. This is content-internal correction, distinct from the researcher changing frozen glosses after failure.

design.mechanism: Enter an attempted action with an owned patient; report an outcome that fails an explicit criterion; bind a diagnosed condition to that failure; issue a superseding instruction for the same patient or explicitly entered related patient. Historical event truth, correctness of a recommendation and success of a later action are separate commitments.
design.unit: Two complete already-exposed prose contexts, including every exact group and alternative reading, nominated before new meanings. Exact context/source IDs and prospective meaning bindings are missing; producer reads no manuscript bodies.
design.contrast: Prior attempt remains recorded while its instruction is superseded versus negative wording erasing the earlier event, changing material identity, or a corrected instruction automatically entailing successful later execution.
design.prediction: One fixed correction/supersession construction must consume the reported failure, a written criterion or diagnosis and a replacement instruction in both whole contexts. The old episode must remain identifiable. If a later success is asserted it requires a separately paid event. Changing existing model values in response to criticism is not evidence for the manuscript containing a correction.
design.scope: Speculative narrative/technical correction role only; no adaptation of FM/FN, no trial-error decoder, no new audit framework and no implied source identity.
